description_en: Creates an isolation rule by calling the CreateIsolationRule operation
description_zh: 调用CreateIsolationRule接口创建隔离规则
kebab_example: aliyun ahas-openapi create-isolation-rule --namespace default --app-name ahas-demo --relation-strategy 0 --threshold 10.0 --enable true --resource handleServiceA --limit-origin default --ref-resource handleServiceB --ahas-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateIsolationRule

parameters.help_en: The application name. If the application is an EDAS application, set AppName to the App ID in EDAS. You can view the App ID on the Application Management > Basic Information page in the EDAS console
parameters.help_zh: 应用名，若为EDAS应用，则AppName为EDAS中的App ID，可在EDAS控制台“应用管理>基本信息”中查看对应的ID
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en:
The statistical dimension. Valid values:
0: current interface.
1: associated interface.
2: chain entry
parameters.help_zh: 统计维度，0表示当前接口，1表示关联接口，2表示链路入口
parameters.name: relation_strategy

parameters.help_en: The concurrency threshold. The value must be an integer greater than or equal to 0
parameters.help_zh: 并发数阈值，取值范围为≥0的整数
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the rule. Default value: false
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en: The resource name. The name cannot exceed 1024 characters and must correspond to the resource name on the interface details page
parameters.help_zh: 资源名。不能超过1024个字符，且该资源名需要与接口详情页面的资源名称相对应
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en: The source application. Default value: default
parameters.name: limit_origin

parameters.help_en: The associated interface name or callstack entry name. This parameter is required when the statistical dimension is set to associated interface or chain entry
parameters.help_zh: 关联接口名、callstack入口名，当统计维度为关联接口或链路入口时需设置该值
parameters.name: ref_resource
